svg.text: Spacecraft EPS: sunlight has to repay the eclipse debt
circular 500 km orbit, β = 0 · array 80 W · load 40 W · battery 100 Wh · charge efficiency 90% (illustrative small-satellite example)
Orbit period 94.6 min, 35.8 min in shadow. Sunlit charging refills the battery every orbit, so the power budget closes.
